title: Tech Note: Dynamic Translation of Fields' Labels

historical_commentary.text: The general need for dynamic field-label localization remains relevant, but current 4D applications have far richer built-in language/resource management and, in Project Mode, more flexible structure definitions, making this specific 2003-era 15-line workaround largely superseded by more robust modern localization tooling.
related_updates: 4D has since added more comprehensive built-in resource/language management features for localization than existed in 2003
Project Mode's text-based structure (introduced in 4D v17) offers more flexible ways to manage structural metadata than the binary structure file this note targeted
